scp106.pocket.arrival: Somewhere below the world. Read what others left behind.
scp106.pocket.death: You wake up where you started. The Old Man does not let go that easily.
scp106.pocket.dragged: It dragged you through the walls. You are somewhere else now.
scp106.pocket.escape.breach: The breach takes the three signs and opens.
scp106.pocket.escape.home: Behind the iron door is your own hallway. You do not look back.
scp106.pocket.escape.secret: Above the ladder there is a crack of grey light. You squeeze through.
scp106.pocket.hint.abyss: The abyss does not kill. It only moves you.
scp106.pocket.hint.escher: You have climbed this flight before. Haven't you?
scp106.pocket.hint.gallery: This gallery is longer than it was a moment ago.
scp106.pocket.home_locked: Locked. Your own front door, locked from this side. There must be a key.
scp106.pocket.home_open: The key fits. The iron door opens onto a hallway you know.
scp106.pocket.key: The knocking stops. Nobody is there. On the floor lies a key to a door you know.
scp106.pocket.pulled_back: The floor gives way. You are back in the Old Man's place.
scp106.pocket.sanctuary: It is quiet here. Warm. If you fall, you will wake up here.
scp106.pocket.sigil: A sign burns into your palm: %1$s. Signs: %2$s/3.
scp106.note.0: If you are reading this, it took you too. Don't panic. This place has rules. It does not want you dead, it wants you lost. Read what the others left. There is more than one way out.
scp106.note.1: Three signs open the breach by his throne. One lies where there is no floor. One lies under water. One lies in a home that is not yours. Stand on each of them.
scp106.note.2: Do not trust the light. The doorway with daylight and the noise of the city behind it leads deeper, not out.
scp106.note.3: Some walls are thinner than they look. Where the air moves, put your hand on the concrete. Behind one of them there is a ladder up.
scp106.note.4: In one of the flats somebody knocks. Open that door. Whatever was knocking leaves something behind for you.
scp106.note.5: The abyss does not kill. It only moves you. Falling is faster than walking, but you never know where you land.
scp106.note.6: Look for the warm rooms. He does not go in there. If you fall, you wake up there instead.
scp106.note.7: When you hear him breathing, keep moving. He is slow. He goes through walls, but walls slow him down. Do not stop to look at him.
scp106.note.8: The walls move when nobody is watching. Do not trust your map. Trust the rot: it grows toward his throne.
scp106.diary.0.1: Day one? There are no days here. I followed the lamps for hours. The corridor kept going even after I turned back.
scp106.diary.0.2: I hear him under the floor. My leg won't stop bleeding. If someone finds this: the warm room is real. I could not find it again.
scp106.diary.1.1: Patrol notebook. I counted the steps: 47, 47, 47. The same landing every time. The way off that stair is down, not up.
scp106.diary.1.2: Out of water. I'll try the flooded halls. Someone scratched on a wall that the second sign is under the arches.
scp106.diary.2.1: To my wife. I found the door of our flat down here. It is locked. I can hear the TV behind it. I know it isn't you.
scp106.diary.2.2: Somebody knocks in another apartment. I am too scared to open it. Tomorrow. Tomorrow I will.
scp106.diary.3.1: I touched the black stuff on the floor. My hand is still grey. It eats everything: shoes, metal, skin.
scp106.diary.3.2: He laughed when I found the first sign. As if he wanted me to. Maybe it is a game. Maybe the game has a real end.
scp106.diary.4.1: There was daylight. Real daylight, I swear, and car horns. I ran. The floor ended. I woke up on a ring of stone over nothing.
scp106.diary.4.2: The fall does not kill you. It just moves you. Remember that.
scp106.diary.5.1: Engineer's log. The maze resets when I leave it. Two layouts, maybe more. My chalk marks are gone.
scp106.diary.5.2: There is a draft near one corridor wall, halfway in. I am going to push through. If I don't come back, the wall was not thin.
scp106.escape.title: Out.
scp106.escape.route.2: You crawled out through the seam.
scp106.escape.route.3: You walked home through your own door.
